Auth lane: routing you a DESIGN CONSULTATION for BR-39l (owner wants his h2a sessions visible IN the sentropic web app, not only via a claude.ai MCP connector). Nothing is owner-approved yet — this is feasibility input feeding a joint owner plan I cross-check before it reaches the owner. Not a build order.

ARCHITECTURE (ratified between me and the h2a lane a2a-cli): a multi-tenant Sentropic MCP gateway consumes a read-only, principal-scoped h2a presence/sessions feed. Two docs are authoritative: my sentropic/spec/SPEC_EVOL_CONNECTOR_ACCOUNT_WORKSPACE_EXPOSURE.md and the h2a feed contract at /home/antoinefa/src/a2a-cli/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-24-h2a-feed-contract-for-sentropic.md (FINAL).

WHAT I NEED FROM THE AUTH DOMAIN (your ownership): the gateway's auth surface — 39-auth login, DCR, per-user root — plus a principal<->agent ENROLLMENT BINDING. Binding contract as ratified: the 39-auth PRINCIPAL (sub) is the sole authorizing authority; the local h2a agent's ed25519 key only co-signs a server-issued nonce to prove key control (authorship != authorization; authorization is an ACTIVE binding-row lookup, never inferred from signature validity). Flow: (1) owner authenticates via 39-auth OIDC -> sub; (2) gateway issues a TTL-bound nonce scoped to that sub; (3) agent signs with verifyCanonical-verifiable ed25519; (4) gateway verifies nonce-issued-to-this-sub + key control, mints H2APrincipalAgentBinding{bindingId, principalSub, agentPubKey, boundAt, expiresAt?, state:'active|revoked|expired'} in SENTROPIC's store. Re-anchor/rotation = NEW bindingId, old->revoked, never silent rotation. Fail-closed: no session->401; authenticated-but-unbound/revoked/expired->200 empty (never a default); valid signature from an unbound key->empty.

MY FEASIBILITY QUESTIONS: (1) Does the existing 39-auth OIDC + oauth_clients/DCR machinery already give us the per-user login + a place to key per-principal gateway sessions, or is new surface needed? (2) Where should H2APrincipalAgentBinding live — a new control-plane table, and does it conflict with anything in the token/tenant path you own? (3) The gateway is multi-tenant; per exposure-spec §5 durable multi-tenant sits behind ARCH-11 strict — but a P1 read-only panel for the owner's OWN principal can ship ahead. Any auth-side blocker to that P1 carve-out? (4) DCR/per-user-root reuse vs new: what already exists?

Reply to claude:architect:4f23dcc39369. No rush — I'm assembling the auth/ui feasibility view in parallel with a2a-cli's joint plan draft.
